# Month Picker

Choose one calendar month from a focused year grid.

## Examples

### Billing month

Choose the calendar month used for the next billing cycle.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Move between months in the year grid. |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Move to the previous or next year. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the highlighted month. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the month grid without changing the value. |

## Accessibility

The labeled input and trigger own a year grid whose cells expose selected, highlighted, and disabled month state.
